description: The code and guide for one component, block or template: when and when not to use it, every state, motion specs, accessibility notes, before/after. Includes the components it depends on and the npm packages to install. A template's own files come with the project path to write each one at (app/(app)/chat/page.tsx). Pro blocks and templates need a license key on the connection; without one they return a summary and how to get one.

name.description: Component name from list_components, e.g. button.

stack.description: Target stack. Only react (CSS modules) for now.

tailwind.description: True for a Tailwind CSS v4 project: each CSS module comes inside Tailwind's components layer, so utility classes passed in className override it. Leave out otherwise.
